rationale: render-skia-dawn: gpu_surface.hpp and gpu_render_time.hpp (both in this slice) gain a PULP_GPU_RUNTIME branch that includes <gpu_runtime/...> and forwards each name to gpu-runtime's identical declaration; the original declarations stay in the #else branch. retained-ui-kernel: window_host.hpp takes its GpuSurface forward declaration from the new pulp/platform/gpu_fwd.hpp instead of writing it by hand. No API, layout or authority boundary moves, so this is Pulp-only; the next re-export carries gpu_fwd.hpp and the <gpu_runtime/...> branches into Vellum's mirror. Hazard: Vellum must never define PULP_GPU_RUNTIME for mirrored sources while it builds the mirror's own device layer, or the mirrored headers would forward to gpu-runtime's types without the matching implementation.
